parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem: A uniform wire is suspended from a fixed support. Masses are added to the other end of the wire, as shown in Fig. 6.1. [Fig. 6.1 (not to scale) shows a wire suspended from a fixed support with masses added to the other end.] The variation of the length $l$ of the wire with the force $F$ applied to the wire by the masses is shown in Fig. 6.2. [Fig. 6.2 shows a graph of $l / \mathrm{m}$ against $F / \mathrm{N}$, with $l$ from $1.998$ to $2.003$ and $F$ from $0$ to $30$.] The cross-sectional area of the wire is $0.95 \, \mathrm{mm^2}$.
parts.text: Determine the unstretched length of the wire.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: For an applied force $F$ of $30 \, \mathrm{N}$, determine: • the stress in the wire • the strain of the wire.

marking_points.text: stress divided by strain / $stress / strain$ / ratio of stress to strain
